segments.name: Services
segments.note: Consulting and support services that help customers run Oracle products.

takeaways.text: Remaining performance obligations — contracts signed but not yet delivered — reached $138B, up 41% in a year, as big customers committed to Oracle's cloud for AI workloads.
takeaways.title: The backlog jumped 41%

takeaways.text: Total cloud revenue — applications plus infrastructure — rose 27% to $6.7B, with cloud infrastructure alone up 52% to $3.0B. Oracle said it expected triple-digit growth in MultiCloud database revenue to continue.
takeaways.title: Cloud kept compounding

takeaways.text: Net income rose 9% to $3.4B even as cloud delivery costs jumped 33% — Oracle is spending heavily to build AI data centers against that backlog. Non-GAAP EPS was $1.70.
takeaways.title: Profit grew through the build-out

verdict: Oracle closed fiscal 2025 with revenue up 11% to $15.9B and net income up 9% to $3.4B — and the real headline was the backlog of signed contracts not yet delivered, which jumped 41% in a year to $138B.
